settings.title: Personalised care in the heart of Mooloolaba

settings.editor: If you are living with Post Traumatic Stress Disorder or Complex PTSD, depression, anxiety, intense emotional distress or an eating disorder, help is here.

The clinic is located in the heart of Mooloolaba, where I offer a high-quality, personalised approach to mental health care. You can expect more one-to-one active attention from an experienced psychologist who will assess and treat your mental health concerns. I treat adults from all walks of life.
I also have published research, read globally, on how early life experiences and trauma affect our experience of the body.
I can help you make sense of the origins of your problems, and build the skills and make the changes needed for a happier and more meaningful life.
In our very first session, we will work together to build a safe, collaborative plan to help you heal and reclaim your life.

Dr Jennifer Malecki, PhD
Psychologist, PhD, PsyBA General | AAPi

settings.title: What we see is only part of the story

settings.editor: Anxiety, low mood or overwhelming emotions are often what bring people to therapy. They are real and they matter, but they are rarely the whole picture.
Approaches such as schema therapy help us gently explore what sits underneath, like early experiences and long-standing patterns, so we can work on causes as well as symptoms.

settings.title: Therapy works with what lies beneath, at a pace that feels safe for you.

settings.editor: Extensive experience with adults living with PTSD, personality disorders, self-harming behaviours, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety, mood disorders, schizophrenia and other serious mental health conditions.
Support through grief and loss, adjustment difficulties, major life transitions, emotional regulation challenges, anger management issues and interpersonal difficulties.
For people who feel depressed or anxious but are unsure why, and who struggle to resolve ongoing problems.

settings.title: Evidence-based therapy that looks at your whole story

settings.editor: I use a range of evidence-based therapies to support clients in their journey towards healing and personal growth, integrating them to stabilise mental health concerns, identify underlying causes and support recovery.
To enrich the therapeutic process, you may choose to integrate arts-based techniques into therapy. Body mapping is used to explore and express aspects of the self, alongside your regular treatment.
